# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mechanically faithful one-screen virtual pet simulator in portrait-first HTML/CSS/JS. The player starts a session, cares for a central plushie mascot with twelve large touch buttons, watches Cozy/Snack/Glow meters decay over time, taps the pet for affection, survives as long as possible, and restarts after a soft failure.

Theme it as: Pet Simulator. A satirical game inspired by anime lo-fi neon city built around pet simulator play, with cozy, creative, relaxing energy, anti anxiety session design, search-friendly hooks like pet simulator, simulator, casual, aesthetics like fairy garden aesthetic, garden aesthetic, plushie aesthetic, and meme-tone cues such as pikachu, main character. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The public identity is Neon Plushie Pet Simulator. The focal actor is Pika-Plush, a satirical electric-yellow plushie main character living in an anime lo-fi neon city fairy garden. Use procedural browser-native visuals: neon towers, fairy sprouts, fireflies, glassy HUD, plushie cheeks/belly, and short calm feedback messages. Preserve all action stat effects, score cadence, and fail semantics.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a browser-native virtual pet care game. The player starts a session, watches three need meters decay, uses twelve one-thumb actions to adjust those meters, taps the pet directly for affection, survives as long as possible, and restarts after a failure. Score increments every five seconds as a day/session counter. Failure occurs when happy/cozy or hunger/snack reaches zero.

## Protected mechanics
- Start and restart flow.
- Three-meter needs management: happy, hunger, energy.
- Base decay value of 2.5 per second with the same sleep and normal decay semantics.
- Twelve actions and their original stat deltas, gates, state timers, and feedback hooks.
- Tap/click hit test around the central pet triggers the PET action.
- Session score increments every five seconds.
- Game-over state hides controls/HUD and reports score.

## Reinterpreted target
Pet Simulator. A satirical game inspired by anime lo-fi neon city built around pet simulator play, with cozy, creative, relaxing energy, anti anxiety session design, search-friendly hooks like pet simulator, simulator, casual, aesthetics like fairy garden aesthetic, garden aesthetic, plushie aesthetic, and meme-tone cues such as pikachu, main character. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The new public surface reframes the caretaker loop as Neon Plushie Pet Simulator: the caretaker keeps a satirical electric plushie mascot calm in an anime lo-fi neon fairy garden.
